chapter: Buffalo, Lunceford, Lil Armstrong and Stuff Smith
title: Back to Stuff's bigger Vendome band on a steady job
summary: Dance interrupts to untangle the chronology; Jones and Stuff got along well and the Vendome job was steady, until Jimmy Smith's invitation to New York came.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Now I got away from Stuff -- oh, yeah, now I've got to go back to when about '32, in the middle of that, things are happening in there, you know, with Stuff awhile and Lunceford awhile, and they sent for me to come down to -- Jimmy Smith was his name, a bass player, out of the Missourians. He wanted me to come to the Savoy and go to work.
Well, hold it one minute, now. Just one second. I keep stopping you at that same place. But tell me -- I mean you and Stuff became so very close.
Well, so you got along good right away, when you went to work with him. I mean you got along good
Oh, yeah, we got along good, but the only thing about this is things change, you know. I'm working in the Vendome again.
With Stuff with a bigger band, and he's in charge of it.
Well, that goes down beautiful because you're right there on a steady job, you know.
